name: Palmdale
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Palmdale for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 14 (Santa at Antelope Valley Mall) through January 3 (Sparkle on the Square lights at Poncitlán Square), with Jolly Holiday (December 5), the Antelope Valley Christmas Parade on Palmdale Blvd (December 12) and Sounds of the Holidays (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Palmdale

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Palmdale
  • 4 free events, including Jolly Holiday (December 5), Light Up the Square and Sparkle on the Square (December 1 to January 3) and the Antelope Valley Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Antelope Valley Mall (November 14 to December 24) and Santa's Workshop at Palmdale Playhouse (December 1 to 12, $7 per reservation)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Light Up the Square (December 1) and the Antelope Valley Christmas Parade on Palmdale Blvd (December 12)
  • Trains: train rides at Jolly Holiday (December 5, free)
  • Season: November 14 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Palmdale families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Los Angeles, which covers L.A. Zoo Lights, the Hollywood Christmas Parade and Los Angeles Ballet's The Nutcracker.
